paragraphs: James completed the sale of his company in April. James and Caroline seek long-term growth with a balanced-to-moderate risk appetite and do not currently require income from their portfolio. James may undertake consultancy work, although this is not settled. Their overriding objective is to build a tax-efficient base that can replace James’s income when he steps back from full-time work in about three years; recommendations should be considered against this goal. They would also like, at some stage, to help with school fees for their grandchildren and possibly make a charitable donation.
